sentences.en: The driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
sentences.zh: 司机要对乘客的安全负责。

sentences.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
sentences.zh: 如果不遵守安全程序，你可能会伤到自己。

sentences.en: But for the safety belt, I wouldn't be alive today.
sentences.zh: 要不是安全带，我今天可能就活不了了。
